code = '''import base64
import hmac
import hashlib


def verify_webhook(raw_body: bytes, hmac_header: str | None, secret: str) -> bool:
    if not hmac_header:
        return False
    try:
        hmac_header.encode("ascii")
    except UnicodeEncodeError:
        return False

    digest = hmac.new(secret.encode("utf8"), raw_body, hashlib.sha256).digest()
    expected = base64.b64encode(digest).decode("ascii")

    return hmac.compare_digest(hmac_header, expected)
'''

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/work')
import importlib
import shopify_webhook
importlib.reload(shopify_webhook)
from shopify_webhook import verify_webhook

import hmac, hashlib, base64

secret = "s3cr3t"
body = b'{"id":123,"name":"#1001"}'

digest = hmac.new(secret.encode("utf8"), body, hashlib.sha256).digest()
valid_header = base64.b64encode(digest).decode("ascii")

tests = []
tests.append(("valid", verify_webhook(body, valid_header, secret), True))
tests.append(("none", verify_webhook(body, None, secret), False))
tests.append(("empty", verify_webhook(body, "", secret), False))
tests.append(("wrong", verify_webhook(body, "AAAA", secret), False))
tests.append(("wrong body", verify_webhook(b"different", valid_header, secret), False))
tests.append(("wrong secret", verify_webhook(body, valid_header, "other"), False))
tests.append(("non-ascii", verify_webhook(body, valid_header + "Ã©", secret), False))
tests.append(("non-ascii only", verify_webhook(body, "hÃ©llo", secret), False))

# tampered but same length, swap last char
bad = valid_header[:-1] + ("A" if valid_header[-1] != "A" else "B")
tests.append(("tampered-last-char", verify_webhook(body, bad, secret), False))

for name, got, expected in tests:
    status = "OK" if got == expected else "FAIL"
    print(status, name, got, expected)
